title: Remote-viewed Martian pyramids as hibernation chambers

tellings.quote: these pyramidal places are like hibernation Chambers they're trying to survive until somebody comes to save them

plain: Pyramid-shaped structures on Mars are hibernation chambers, where beings are waiting to survive until someone comes to rescue them. This comes from Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, meaning someone trained to try to see distant or hidden places with the mind alone. He tells Michels he perceived it himself in a session: "these pyramidal places are like hibernation chambers, they're trying to survive until somebody comes to save them." If true, it would mean Mars once held intelligent life that is still waiting there.
